title: Stop copying the secret values of custom MCP servers into project files
summary: Maestro no longer writes the secret values of the user's own MCP servers (its custom servers and those from the user's Claude Code settings) into a project's .mcp.json; custom servers now go into the user's own Claude Code settings, and hand-written project entries are left untouched. The owner must try the change, then merge pull request #714.
lessons_learned: The issue named only Maestro's custom-server store, but the leaked key on the maintainer's machine came through the discovered-servers path from ~/.claude.json; check every write path against the real symptom before building

deferred.what: A Maestro custom server that is switched on now also shows in the Infra MCP list's User section, so the user sees it twice
deferred.why: Not asked for by this issue and it changes the screen
